blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The late Batanes Rep. Ciriaco Gato was able to leave a positive impact on legislation as he brought to the House of Representatives a perspective that comes from a caring physician. House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III made the statement on Tuesday as the chamber condoles with the family of Gato, who died on Monday. Gato was 66. “The entire House of Representatives expresses its sympathy to the family and loved ones of Congressman Ciriaco Gato,” Dy said. “We also stand with the whole province of Batanes who lost a public servant that they have trusted for a long […]...
